newsitem.title: CHINA: Explosion reported in park in central Beijing.
newsitem.headline: Explosion reported in park in central Beijing.

text.p: An explosion rocked a park just a few hundred yards (metres) from the heart of government in China's capital, Beijing, on Tuesday but police officials declined to say whether the blast was caused by a bomb.
"We are investigating," said a police official at the police station at the Zhongshan park in the heart of Beijing.
"We will report the details to the public when we are ready," the police official said.

She declined to say if anyone was injured in the blast or if it caused serious damage in the park in the heart of Beijing beside the Forbidden City that was home to China's emperors and just across the road from the Great Hall of the People where China's leaders meet.
"I can make no further comment," she said, refusing to say whether it was caused by a bomb.
